title: Patch: Training Grounds' Legacy cards redrawn in the yard's own art style
thread:
**Issue #2724 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2724: Patch: Training Grounds' Legacy cards redrawn in the yard's own art style
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

The 20 Legacy cards of Training Grounds (`traininggrounds-041` to `traininggrounds-060`, docs/training-grounds-set.md TG2) are snapshots of Core cards. Today each draws **exactly** its Core card's picture (`SNAPSHOT_ART` in `apps/web/src/cards/art/traininggrounds.ts`, which `CardArt.tsx` follows through `snapshotArtOf`). Only the `Legacy:` name and tag set it apart (R503, R2511000). The rest of the set draws the yard: a sky, a palisade and a sand floor under one subject (R2202000).

The owner wants each Legacy card **tweaked in the Training Grounds style**, so it has an identity of its own while staying recognisably the card it freezes:

- **Keep the subject.** Keep the Core card's subject and its composition, so a player who knows the Core card knows this one.
- **Redraw it in the yard's style:** set it in the yard (its sky, palisade and sand floor, and its palette) with the set's materials (wood, straw, rope, canvas). Add a practice-yard touch or two that suit the card, such as a straw target, a wooden practice sword, a chalk tally or a training-dummy stitch. Twenty variations of one overlay will not do: each card gets its own touches.
- **Both faces:** base and Radiant. The Radiant keeps its gold rays, and the two faces differ only in their paint, as the set's other cards do.
- **Pure and deterministic,** like the rest of the set's art: a function of the card's id, name, tags and type, drawn from the same seeded streams.
- **No other card's picture moves.** Every Core card keeps its art exactly (R503).

This amends R2511000 (and R503's "a Legacy card and its Core card look the same") with a ruling note in this issue's block. It is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). It changes how cards look, so a pending fragment claims it (a micro, R2529000).

**#2681 overlap:** #2681 (release art, being built now) adds `proceduralCardArtUri` to `apps/web/src/cards/art/svg.ts`, which copies `CardArt`'s Legacy path. If it lands first, this issue's Legacy art must flow through it too. Its test compares the URI with `CardArt`'s, so it will catch a miss.

## Acceptance

- Each of the 20 Legacy cards' art, base and Radiant, differs from its Core card's art. A test holds that each still draws its Core card's subject and draws the yard's layers.
- No two Legacy cards share the same yard touch, and a test holds every `SNAPSHOT_ART` entry to having one.
- Every Core card's art, and every other Training Grounds card's, is byte-for-byte unchanged (snapshot test).
- A component (pixel) spec shows each Legacy card beside its Core card.
- The ruling note passes `cargo jackioh spec check`, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes with the fragment.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing blocks it. Coordinate with #2681 as above.
```
